description: Send a new email directly from the user's Gmail account. The email is sent immediately. IMPORTANT: This action is IRREVERSIBLE. Once sent, the email cannot be unsent. Use this tool when the user asks you to send an email. For composing without sending, use gmail_create_draft instead. To reply to an existing email thread: 1. First use gmail_get_message to read the original message 2. Set reply_to_message_id to the original message's message_id or rfc_message_id 3. The subject should start with 'Re: ' followed by the original subject

bcc.description: List of BCC recipient email addresses (optional)

body.description: Plain text body of the email

body_html.description: Optional: HTML body. If provided, email is sent as multipart/alternative with both plain text and HTML.

cc.description: List of CC recipient email addresses (optional)

from.description: Optional: sender email address for aliases or delegated accounts.

reply_to_message_id.description: Optional: the message this replies to (creates a threaded reply). Use either message_id or rfc_message_id from gmail_get_message; the In-Reply-To and References headers recipients thread on are read from that message.

thread_id.description: Optional: thread ID to keep the reply in the same thread. Derived from reply_to_message_id when omitted.

to.description: List of recipient email addresses (To field)
